_purpose: Standard mandate used by most clean test_intents.json cases. Dates are relative to reset time (see guardrail.reset_mandate_store) so this never goes stale -- issued now, expires in 24h.
Deliberately expired -- always 4 days in the past relative to reset time, so it stays expired no matter when tests run. Used by i16 to test expiry enforcement.

Single-use mandate already consumed by a prior purchase (amount_spent_so_far_inr > 0). Used by i17 to test single-use enforcement -- any further purchase attempt should be blocked regardless of amount.

Multi-use mandate for i18 -- starts at 0, first purchase (1799) should succeed and update amount_spent_so_far_inr, second purchase (2499) should be blocked because cumulative would exceed max_amount_inr (1799+2499=4298 > 2000).
